links.outcome: Physician diagnostic reasoning score with versus without LLM access, compared with LLM alone
links.effect: Median score 76% (LLM group) vs 74% (conventional), adjusted difference 2 percentage points (95% CI -4 to 8; P=.60); LLM alone scored 16 points higher than conventional group (P=.03).
links.quote: The LLM alone demonstrated higher performance than both physician groups, indicating the need for technology and workforce development to realize the potential of physician-artificial intelligence collaboration in clinical practice.

screen.reason: Randomized trial assessing the effect of LLM availability on physician diagnostic reasoning using clinical vignettes compared to conventional resources alone.
